headline: Integra Resources Reports Third-Quarter Gold Production of 17,652 Ounces
summary: Integra Resources announced its operational figures for the third quarter, highlighting total gold production of 17,652 ounces.
why: Integra Resources is a mining development company focused on precious metal exploration and production assets in North America.

impacts.name: Integra Resources Corp
impacts.why: Quarterly production updates provide baseline operational metrics for mining valuation analysis.
